description: Machine-readable workflow contract for brand learning and host apply.

learn-brand.goal: Learn a brand visual language and materialize reusable MOD/style-pack/demo assets without touching a host project by default.

steps.label: Collect our own computed, asset, and action evidence
Run TPP blocking gate before any mapping or preview output
Map brand evidence to dangoui-compatible tokens and roles
Generate brand-mod.json and demo preview artifacts

boundaries: Do not modify host business project by default.
Brand key is a style identifier, never a route or page name.
Third-party extraction is seed evidence only, never final mapping truth.

apply-host.goal: Apply an existing learned visual language into a real host project while preserving host business logic and content.

steps.label: Detect host entry, selector map, and visual debt
Run TPP blocking gate before applying into host
Map learned language to host dangoui and component structure
Apply and verify preview in host project

boundaries: Preserve host route, business content, and component API unless user explicitly asks otherwise.
Do not create a new brand route by default.
Final preview URL must be the host project URL, not the demo URL.
